close_one_liner: Obj B fails constructively — under the residual>=0.05 gate no cell admits. The residuals are small mainly because the absolute recoverable NDCG gaps are small, and the dev-selected gated local ridge frequently does not even beat the no-op floor. This does NOT show local ridge dominates chelation; it shows the synthetic preflight could not construct a discriminating home-turf residual under small-magnitude non-affine warps, so no GPU chelation run is justified.
